title: Settings
closeFiltersLabel: Close the filter panel after applying
closeFiltersDesc: Automatically closes the panel when you select "Apply filters".
elevationDesc: Your choice affects analysis accuracy and data download time.
elevationSefinekDesc: GEDTM30 terrain model (~30 m, fusion of ICESat-2/GEDI/Copernicus/ALOS) with bilinear interpolation. Likely the most accurate of the available sources.
elevationOpenElevationDesc: SRTM data (~30-90 m). Free public API with no availability guarantee - can be overloaded or temporarily unreachable.
coverageStyleDesc: Tiles: the darker the tile, the higher the chance of reception. Lines show the optical range and Fresnel zone boundaries.
elevationOpenMeteoDesc: Copernicus DEM GLO-90 (90 m). A fast, reliable API, but the data is less detailed in uneven terrain.
apiKeysDesc: You can optionally enter your own keys for Esri, MapTiler and CARTO maps. They replace the built-in keys, whose quotas are shared by users. Keys are saved on this device and sent only to the relevant map provider. Use them according to the provider's terms.
apiKeysPlaceholder: Leave blank to use the built-in key
apiKeysActive: Your own key is in use.
apiKeysInvalid: An API key must be 8-512 characters long. Allowed characters: A-Z, a-z, digits and - _ . ~
generalDesc: How the map and its panels behave.
toolsDesc: Data sources and appearance of the terrain and coverage tools.
mapsDesc: Base maps and the API keys they use.
dataDesc: What this browser stores for the map and how to reset it.
rememberViewDesc: Restores your last map view when you return. A position specified in a link takes precedence.
showScaleDesc: A metric scale bar in the bottom-left corner of the map.
hapticsDesc: A short vibration when you tap buttons, on devices that support it.
mapLanguageDesc: Language of place names on the vector maps (OpenFreeMap, MapTiler, Esri). The page reloads after a change.
resetDesc: Restores default settings and the default base map, and removes your API keys and last map view. Keeps filters and saved tool data.
clearDesc: Removes everything this site stores in your browser: settings, filters, measurements and routes.
